executive_summary.headline: Diwali Day 3 GMV hit $38.4M; Bhiwandi and payments incidents need containment tonight
executive_summary.narrative: Day 3 closed at $38.4M GMV across 612,000 orders, up 34% YoY against the $28.6M baseline plan. Bhiwandi FC-WEST-01 absorbed 194,000 parcels against a 145,000 daily cap, dropping 24-hour Assured SLA to 86.2% versus the 96.5% guarantee, with 41,800 staged cages backlogged. A UPI webhook latency incident between 10:12Z and 11:48Z created 3,410 duplicate holds totaling $318,400; 430 high-value holds ($61,250) still need manual reconciliation before the T+1 cutoff.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Unmitigated exposure of $374,580 versus $24,200 containment spend, a 15.5x ratio.

key_findings.theme: Western hub sortation capacity and dispatch SLA breach
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Bhiwandi received 194,000 parcels in 18 hours against a 145,000 daily rated cap, with sorter availability at 81.4% and dispatch SLA at 86.2% versus the 96.5% target, leaving 41,800 cages staged.

key_findings.theme: Payments webhook latency causing duplicate authorization holds
key_findings.quantified_evidence: UPI webhook p99 latency rose from 420ms to 4,850ms, producing 14,920 PENDING_RECONCILIATION attempts and 3,410 duplicate holds totaling $318,400; duplicates fell to 0.02% after 12:00Z.

key_findings.theme: Seller penalty disputes and buyer ticket surge
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Inbound P1 tickets rose 210% above forecast with 11,400 incremental tickets in 6 hours; 312 Gate-3-verified sellers qualify for waivers while 47 phantom-manifest accounts require audit.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Carrier surcharges and linehaul rebate forfeiture
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Missing the 13:30Z dock release triggers $77,330 in carrier surcharges and $142,000 rebate forfeiture risk if Western on-time tender falls below 92.0% for Week 46.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Deploy 18 BlueDart Gate-7 closed-body trailers from 17:00Z at $14,400 standby fee and clear the 41,800 cage backlog before 23:59Z.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 430 unresolved duplicate UPI holds worth $61,250 must settle before the 04:00Z T+1 batch, or customers face extended temporary holds and reconciliation breaks.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Manually reconcile the 430 holds before 04:00Z while keeping Cashfree-Rail-B at 70% primary weight and 8-second idempotency leases.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Seller penalty fairness and marketplace abuse
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Blanket LDP waivers would mask 47 phantom-manifest sellers while 312 verified sellers face unfair 4-hour Gate 3 queues; Assured voucher risk reaches $94,000 if backlog exceeds 16 hours.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Issue Gate-3 dock-timestamp waivers only to the 312 verified sellers and place the 47 phantom-manifest accounts on a 7-day inventory audit.

action_plan.owner: Rohan Kulkarni, Director Bhiwandi & Western Hub Sortation
action_plan.milestone: Deploy 18 BlueDart trailers at Gate 7 by 17:00Z, add 140 night-shift loaders, and move oversized kitchen appliances off Sorter Lane 4 to manual pallet staging.
action_plan.verification_metric: Staged backlog below 10,000 cages and dispatch SLA at or above 96.5% by 23:59Z.

action_plan.owner: Meera Subramanian, Principal SRE Checkout & Payments
action_plan.milestone: Reconcile the 430 remaining manual duplicate UPI holds worth $61,250 and retain Cashfree-Rail-B at 70% primary weight.
action_plan.verification_metric: Zero unreconciled duplicate holds and duplicate auth rate held at or below 0.02%.

action_plan.owner: Kabir Sethi, Head of 3PL Carrier Contracts & SLA Governance
action_plan.milestone: Confirm BlueDart standby fleet terms, track Western on-time tender weekly, and issue Gate-3 LDP waivers for 312 verified sellers while auditing 47 phantom accounts.
action_plan.target_window: Standby confirmed by 17:00Z; waivers and audit within 7 days
action_plan.verification_metric: Western on-time tender at or above 92.0% and 47 audited seller accounts resolved within 7 days.

key_findings.theme: Carrier surcharge and rebate exposure
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Missed 13:30Z dock release triggers $1.85 per-parcel surcharges totaling $77,330 unmitigated, plus $142,000 weekly rebate forfeiture risk if Western on-time tender falls below 92.0%, and $94,000 Assured voucher risk.

key_findings.quantified_evidence: Between 10:12Z and 11:48Z, p99 webhook latency rose from 420ms to 4,850ms, creating 14,920 pending reconciliations and 3,410 duplicate holds ($318,400); 2,980 auto-reversed, leaving 430 holds ($61,250) pending manual settlement.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Issue LDP waivers only for 312 Gate-3-verified sellers using dock-in timestamps and place 47 phantom-manifest accounts on a 7-day inventory audit.

key_findings.theme: Undeclared energy density and air-routing risk

executive_summary.headline: Misdeclared lithium power bank ignited in Pune; contained with zero injuries, sweeping seller audit followed
executive_summary.narrative: On August 29, 2026, a misdeclared seller power bank carton at FC-PUNE-02 reached 118C and was isolated in 260 seconds with zero injuries. Forensics found 99.16Wh cells labeled 37Wh and a forged BIS certificate. The 412-SKU audit found 334 compliant, 63 suspended, and 15 delisted, with 4 sellers terminated and 1,420 buyers notified.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Direct losses total $17,260 against $184,000 frozen escrow, covering the $58,220 recall reserve; $412,000 monthly GMV quarantined.

key_findings.theme: Seller misdeclaration and forged certification caused the thermal runaway
key_findings.quantified_evidence: TUV tear-down found 26,800mAh/99.16Wh cells inside shells stamped 10,000mAh/37Wh; forged BIS certificate used; carton rose from 47C to 118C in 9 minutes.

key_findings.theme: Fleet-wide audit exposed material catalog non-compliance
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Of 412 SKUs across 118 sellers, 334 (81.1%) compliant, 63 (15.3%) suspended with $412,000 monthly GMV quarantined, and 15 (3.6%) delisted across 4 terminated sellers.

key_findings.theme: Recall progress is strong but incomplete
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Recall notices reached 1,420 buyers of falsified SKUs; completion was 61.4% at September 30, leaving 548 units unreturned against a $58,220 refund reserve.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Dangerous goods transport and air manifest exposure
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Misdeclared energy density (37Wh listed versus 88.8-99.2Wh actual) risked undeclared lithium reaching passenger air manifests; 114 such shipments were blocked in September.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Hard TMS API block prevents standalone UN3480 packs and spare batteries above 37Wh from routing to passenger or belly air manifests.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: A forged BIS IS 16046 certificate passed manual PDF review in April 2026, enabling 15 falsified SKUs across 4 sellers to sell to 1,420 customers.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Real-time BIS/UL registry API cross-check replaced manual review on September 10, 2026, plus a Category 1 OCR contradiction gate.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Facility fire safety and inbound screening coverage
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 10 of 18 Tier-2 sortation spokes still lack FLIR handheld thermal screening, leaving residual inbound detection gaps outside the top 12 hubs.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Deploy FLIR handheld cameras to all 10 remaining spokes using $42,000 approved capex, with 100% dock scanning continuing at top hubs.

action_plan.milestone: Close all 548 open recall returns through escalated SMS and IVR follow-ups, offering prepaid hazardous-return kits and instant 100% refunds to affected buyers.
action_plan.verification_metric: Recall completion reaches 100% of 1,420 buyer units

action_plan.milestone: Deploy FLIR handheld thermal imaging across the remaining 10 Tier-2 regional sortation spokes using the approved $42,000 capital expenditure budget.
action_plan.verification_metric: 18 of 18 Tier-2 spokes operating FLIR dock screening

action_plan.milestone: Sustain zero-tolerance auto-delisting for UN38.3 or BIS tampering and pursue the Economic Offences Wing referral while retaining seller escrow.
action_plan.target_window: Ongoing; review at next quarterly audit
action_plan.verification_metric: Zero falsified-document SKUs live; escrow covers 100% of recall costs

executive_summary.headline: Escrow holds mostly false positives; SLA breaches and PII leakage need urgent fixes
executive_summary.narrative: Across 1,850 audited sellers ($684M GMV cohort), 214 accounts triggered ESCROW_HOLD_409 holds totaling $4.82M. Audit found 146 holds (68.2%) were false-positive name-normalization mismatches, while 68 holds ($1.41M) reflected genuine compliance gaps. Median manual review reached 83.5 hours against a 48-hour contractual cap, with 52 holds exceeding 72 hours. Pre-gate logging echoed 194 raw sensitive PII artifacts; post-gate leakage is now zero. Sanctions screening found zero SDN breaches, and 14 shell-ring accounts blocked $286,000 synthetic GMV.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Persistent SLA slippage projects roughly $147,500 quarterly arbitration and interest exposure, reducible by separating false positives.

key_findings.theme: False-positive escrow holds dominate ESCROW_HOLD_409 triggers
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Of 214 ESCROW_HOLD_409 triggers totaling $4.82M, 146 holds (68.2%) were false-positive legal-suffix normalization mismatches, while 68 holds carried genuine compliance gaps.

key_findings.theme: Review SLA breached and Section 14.3 arbitration exposure
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Median manual review reached 83.5 hours versus the 48-hour contractual cap, with 52 holds beyond 72 hours and three Section 14.3 arbitration notices issued by Tier-1 sellers.

key_findings.theme: PII leakage remediated and AML shell rings blocked
key_findings.quantified_evidence: 194 raw PII artifacts were logged before the regex gate and zero after; 14 shell-ring accounts blocked $286,000 synthetic GMV with zero SDN sanctions breaches.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Median review of 83.5 hours exceeds the 48-hour cap, leaving 52 holds beyond 72 hours and about $147,500 quarterly projected dispute cost if slippage persists.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Separate benign suffix mismatches from genuine gaps and route false positives to a 12-hour fast lane for clean Platinum sellers.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 194 raw SSN, PAN, and card strings were echoed into support logs before the regex gate, though post-gate leakage is now reported as zero.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Enforce deterministic sub-millisecond regex masking at ingestion and route tax credentials to a FIPS-140-3 KMS tokenized vault.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Genuine gaps include 41 stale UBO or board registries, 19 out-of-jurisdiction IBAN payouts, and 8 velocity-flagged bank swaps; 14 shells were blocked.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Require refreshed UBO and board authorizations within 18 months and FEMA/tax documentation for cross-border IBAN payouts.

executive_summary.headline: False-positive escrow holds and SLA slippage create arbitration exposure despite zero sanctions breaches and clean PII remediation
executive_summary.narrative: Across 1,850 audited sellers, 214 triggered ESCROW_HOLD_409 holds totaling $4.82M; 146 (68.2%) were false-positive name mismatches versus 68 genuine gaps worth $1.41M. Median review reached 83.5 hours against a 48-hour cap. All 194 exposed PII artifacts were purged, with zero leakage after the regex gate.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Persistent SLA slippage projects roughly $147,500 quarterly arbitration exposure, though $286,000 synthetic GMV was blocked and zero sanctions breaches occurred.

key_findings.theme: Escrow hold false-positive rate
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Of 214 ESCROW_HOLD_409 holds totaling $4.82M, 146 (68.2%) were string-normalization false positives, while 68 holds representing $1.41M reflected genuine compliance gaps.

key_findings.theme: Section 14.3 SLA breach and PII exposure
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Median review hit 83.5 hours versus 48 contractual; 52 holds exceeded 72 hours, three arbitration pre-notices followed, and 194 raw PII artifacts reached support logs before regex gating.

key_findings.theme: Sanctions and shell-ring AML detection
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Nightly screening covered 100% of sellers with 0 SDN breaches; device-graph and GSTIN clustering blocked 14 shell accounts and $286,000 of attempted synthetic GMV before T+7 settlement.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Observed 83.5-hour median review versus 48-hour cap; 31 accounts aged beyond 72 hours, with three Tier-1 arbitration pre-notices already issued.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Dedicated 12-hour fast-lane for false-positive holds on Platinum sellers with chargeback rate below 0.3% and clean KYC history.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Genuine KYC and Cross-Border Compliance Gaps
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 68 accounts holding $1.41M: 41 stale UBO registries, 19 unauthorized third-party IBAN routes lacking FEMA documentation, 8 velocity-flagged bank swaps.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Deploy legal-suffix canonicalizer plus micro-deposit name check, so manual review capacity concentrates on genuine UBO, IBAN and velocity risks.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 194 raw SSN, PAN and card artifacts entered general support logs before remediation; historical tokens purged within 72 hours, with zero post-gate leakage.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Enforce sub-millisecond deterministic regex masking at ingestion and route tax documents to an encrypted FIPS-140-3 KMS vault.

action_plan.milestone: Deploy legal-suffix normalizer (LLC/Pvt Ltd/Inc) with instant micro-deposit name check to cut false-positive 409 holds by 65% before activation.
action_plan.verification_metric: False-positive 409 holds reduced 65% from 68.2% baseline rate

action_plan.milestone: Maintain zero-PII ticket vault with deterministic regex masking at seller portal ingestion and tokenized secure tax-document upload, keeping SSN/PAN out of tickets.
action_plan.verification_metric: Zero PII artifacts leaked in support logs after regex gate

action_plan.milestone: Launch dedicated 12-hour SLA fast-lane for false-positive holds on qualifying Platinum sellers to cut arbitration exposure from 48-hour breaches.
action_plan.verification_metric: Median review time at or below 48-hour contractual SLA

key_findings.quantified_evidence: Missed 13:30Z dock releases trigger $1.85 per-parcel surcharges totaling $77,330, plus $142,000 weekly rebate forfeiture risk if Western on-time tender falls below 92.0%.

executive_summary.headline: AetherSonic Exclusive Onboarding Delivers $18M Year-1 GMV with Gated MAP Protection
executive_summary.narrative: AetherSonic proposes 28 SKUs on NovaMart as Official Brand Storefront with SKU-level brand gating, serial capture at pack-out, and MAP lock within ±0.5%. AetherSonic commits $18.0M Year-1 inventory allocation including 45-day StudioPulse X2 exclusivity (32,000 launch-quarter units, $11.168M GMV). NovaMart concedes 175bps commission reduction to 9.75% and a $3.65 FBO fee, offset by $480,000 guaranteed co-op spend at a 4.8x ROAS floor.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Net positive: $315K commission concession offset by $954K projected return-savings and $480K co-op commitment.

key_findings.theme: Grey-market MAP leakage and returns erode AetherSonic economics
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Unauthorized resellers undercut MAP by 14%-19%, returns run 7.8%, and transit averages 4.1 days, capping accessory attach at 8.4% on $31.2M current GMV.

key_findings.theme: Fulfillment and return-rate gains justify fee concessions
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Overbox cohort cuts transit crush returns from 7.4% to 2.1%, projecting $954,000 annual GMV retention, against a $0.75/unit FBO discount from $4.40 to $3.65.

key_findings.theme: Commission concession and co-op spend trade-off
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Commission falls from 11.5% to 9.75% on $18M GMV, a ~$315,000 annual concession, versus $480,000 minimum co-op spend yielding net take rate 12.42%.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Leakage above 2.0% over any 14-day audit window grants AetherSonic a 30-day exclusivity unwind right, threatening the $18M Year-1 allocation and launch economics.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Enforce Brand Registry Lock on 28 UPCs by January 10, 2027, auto-reject unsigned tokens, and block 19 known grey-market resellers at catalog ingestion.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Transit damage, counterfeit returns, and serial fraud
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Transit crush returns at 7.4% baseline and counterfeit return swaps create write-off exposure; the 2.1% overbox target depends on packaging and scan compliance across four hubs.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Mandate double-walled overbox in the $3.65 tier and pair Order ID to Master Box and battery serial scans at pack-out, triggering Buyer Abuse Hold on mismatches.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Settlement, reserve, and UN38.3 hazmat clearance
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: T+3 settlement requires Director approval and zero KYC/TIN mismatches; 2 of 28 UN38.3 certifications remain pending lab signoff, risking launch stock quarantine.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Secure Director approval for T+3 release tied to $250,000 rolling reserve for 90 days, and obtain the 2 pending UN38.3 lab signoffs before Go-Live.

action_plan.milestone: Enroll all 28 AetherSonic UPCs/EANs into Brand Registry Lock and enforce signed Authorized Distributor Token ingestion gating.
action_plan.verification_metric: 28 of 28 UPCs/EANs locked with 0% manual override

action_plan.milestone: Install serial-capture scanning at Bhiwandi, Dankuni, Hoskote, and Tauru pick-and-pack stations before carrier handoff.
action_plan.verification_metric: 4 of 4 hubs scanning Order ID, Master Box, and battery serials

action_plan.milestone: Conduct Day 30, Day 60, and Day 90 QBRs auditing ROAS against 4.8x, MAP leakage below 2.0%, and 60-day returns at or below 2.5%.
action_plan.verification_metric: Net ROAS at or above 4.8x and returns at or below 2.5%

executive_summary.headline: Seller misdeclared lithium cells triggered contained FC-PUNE-02 thermal event; fleet audit delisted 15 SKUs
executive_summary.narrative: On August 29, 2026, a sealed seller carton at FC-PUNE-02 Zone-C reached 118C and was isolated in 260 seconds with zero injuries. Forensics showed Seller SLR-77401 packed 26,800mAh cells in shells labeled 10,000mAh, with a forged BIS certificate. A 412-SKU audit found 334 compliant, 63 suspended, and 15 permanently delisted SKUs across 4 terminated sellers.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Net Q3 cost $79,480 plus $184,000 escrow frozen against buyer refunds and liability exposure.

key_findings.theme: Containment incident and seller misdeclaration at FC-PUNE-02
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Carton temperature rose from 47C to 118C in 9 minutes; isolation took 260 seconds. 180 units damaged ($4,860) and $12,400 remediation, with zero injuries.

key_findings.theme: Fleet-wide compliance audit of hazmat SKUs
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Of 412 audited SKUs, 334 (81.1%) were compliant, 63 (15.3%) suspended with $412,000 GMV quarantined, and 15 (3.6%) permanently delisted across 4 sellers.

key_findings.theme: Buyer recall and open return exposure
key_findings.quantified_evidence: 1,420 buyers notified; $58,220 refund reserve booked; 61.4% completion as of September 30 leaves 548 units unreturned.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Undeclared dangerous goods and air transport
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Sellers understated energy density by 140%–168%, with 114 undeclared air shipments blocked in September. Undeclared cells risk passenger-aircraft fire exposure.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Hard TMS API block on over-37Wh batteries plus Category 1 OCR contradiction gate comparing listing claims against carton labels before Air-Express eligibility.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Seller document fraud and product certification
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Forged BIS IS 16046 certificate and falsified UN38.3 records passed manual PDF review, creating statutory liability and buyer harm exposure.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Real-time BIS/UL registry API cross-check deployed 2026-09-10, replacing manual PDF review, with auto-delisting for document tampering.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 548 recalled units remain unreturned from 1,420 buyers, and 10 of 18 Tier-2 spokes lack FLIR screening, leaving residual thermal-event risk.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Escalated SMS and IVR follow-ups targeting closure by November 15, 2026, with FLIR handheld rollout to remaining spokes by November 30, 2026 ($42,000 capex).

action_plan.milestone: Close all 548 open customer recall returns through escalated SMS and IVR follow-up campaigns for affected buyers.
action_plan.verification_metric: Open unreturned recall units reduced from 548 to zero

action_plan.milestone: Deploy FLIR handheld thermal imaging across the remaining 10 Tier-2 regional sortation spokes using approved capex.
action_plan.verification_metric: 10 of 10 pending Tier-2 spokes show FLIR deployment completion

action_plan.milestone: Maintain zero-tolerance auto-delisting for sellers attempting UN38.3 or BIS document tampering across all marketplace categories.
action_plan.verification_metric: Zero tampered-document sellers remain active in quarterly audit

structured_draft.document_title: NovaMart Q3 FY2026 Lithium-Ion Hazmat Safety Filing: Pune FC-PUNE-02 Thermal Event and Marketplace Audit

executive_summary.headline: Misdeclared power bank thermal event contained with zero injuries; 15 SKUs delisted, controls deployed
executive_summary.narrative: On August 29, 2026, a misdeclared power bank carton at FC-PUNE-02 reached 118C and was isolated in 260 seconds with zero injuries. Forensics found forged BIS documents and undeclared 99.16Wh cells. A 412-SKU audit left 334 compliant, suspended 63, and delisted 15 across 4 terminated sellers. 1,420 buyers were notified.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Direct losses total $17,260 plus a $58,220 refund reserve, backed by $184,000 frozen seller escrow; 63 SKUs quarantined.

key_findings.theme: Rapid containment of thermal runaway
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Carton temperature rose from 47C to 118C in 9 minutes; sensors triggered within 110 seconds and ERT isolation took 260 seconds, with zero injuries and operations resumed by 08:30 IST.

key_findings.theme: Seller misdeclaration and document forgery
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Cells of 26,800mAh/99.16Wh were packed in shells labelled 10,000mAh/37Wh; a forged BIS certificate was used; 114 undeclared air shipments were blocked in September.
key_findings.source_anchor: Section A findings; Section C audit

key_findings.theme: Fleet audit and recall progress
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Of 412 SKUs, 334 are compliant (81.1%), 63 suspended (15.3%), 15 delisted (3.6%); recall reached 1,420 buyers with 61.4% completion and 548 units still unreturned.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Marketplace seller document integrity (UN38.3 / BIS IS 16046)
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Forged BIS certificate passed manual PDF review in April 2026; 15 SKUs across 4 sellers carried falsified safety documents or undeclared cells above 100Wh.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Automated real-time BIS/UL registry API cross-check deployed September 10, 2026, plus zero-tolerance auto-delisting and referral of forged certificate evidence to enforcement authorities.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Air and surface dangerous goods transport routing
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Listings understated energy by 140%-168% (37Wh stated versus 88.8-99.2Wh actual); 114 undeclared air shipments were blocked during September before carrier handoff.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Hard TMS API block on spare batteries above 37Wh and UN3480 packs, plus a Category 1 OCR contradiction gate gating Air-Express eligibility.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Open buyer recall and Tier-2 screening gaps
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 548 recalled units remain unreturned at 61.4% completion, and 10 of 18 Tier-2 sortation spokes still lack FLIR handheld thermal screening cameras.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Escalated SMS and IVR follow-ups, $42,000 approved capex for FLIR rollout, and $58,220 refund reserve backed by $184,000 frozen seller escrow.

action_plan.milestone: Close all 548 open recall returns through escalated SMS and IVR follow-ups, using prepaid hazardous-return kits and instant refunds for affected buyers.
action_plan.verification_metric: Recall completion reaches 100% of 1,420 notified buyer units

action_plan.milestone: Deploy FLIR handheld thermal imaging at the remaining 10 Tier-2 regional sortation spokes under the approved $42,000 capital budget.
action_plan.verification_metric: All 18 Tier-2 spokes confirmed operating FLIR inbound screening

action_plan.milestone: Maintain auto-delisting for seller UN38.3 or BIS tampering and sustain Economic Offences Wing referral and escrow retention for buyer refunds.
action_plan.target_window: Continuous; next audit checkpoint Q4 FY2026
action_plan.verification_metric: Zero forged-document SKUs live; escrow covers 100% of recall refunds

executive_summary.narrative: Of 1,850 audited sellers, 214 triggered ESCROW_HOLD_409 holds totaling $4.82M. Median manual review reached 83.5 hours against a 48-hour contractual cap, with 52 sellers held beyond 72 hours. Before regex gating, 194 raw sensitive PII artifacts reached support logs; post-gate leakage is zero.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Projected Section 14.3 arbitration and interest exposure of about $147,500 per quarter if SLA slippage persists.

key_findings.theme: False-positive escrow holds from name-normalization mismatches
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Of 214 ESCROW_HOLD_409 triggers, 146 (68.2%) were false-positive legal-suffix mismatches; only 68 accounts ($1.41M of $4.82M held) reflected genuine compliance gaps requiring retained holds.

key_findings.theme: Manual review SLA breach and arbitration exposure
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Median manual review reached 83.5 hours versus the 48-hour contractual cap, with 52 sellers held over 72 hours and three Tier-1 Section 14.3 arbitration pre-notices filed against $412k trailing GMV each.

key_findings.theme: PII leakage remediated and shell-ring prevention
key_findings.quantified_evidence: 194 raw SSN, PAN, and card artifacts were logged before the regex gate; post-gate leakage is 0. Device-graph clustering blocked 14 shell accounts and $286,000 synthetic GMV with zero SDN breaches.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Median review of 83.5 hours exceeds the 48-hour contractual cap, leaving 52 sellers held beyond 72 hours and driving projected arbitration cost of $147,500 per quarter.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Deploy legal-suffix normalizer and instant micro-deposit name check to prevent false-positive holds, plus a 12-hour fast-lane for clean Platinum sellers.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 194 raw SSN, PAN, and settlement card strings were echoed into general support logs before deterministic regex gating was deployed, creating statutory privacy exposure.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Enforce sub-millisecond regex masking at portal ingestion and route tax credentials to a FIPS-140-3 KMS tokenized vault with zero PII in tickets.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: 68 accounts with stale UBO registries, offshore IBAN routing, or velocity bank swaps carry $1.41M exposure; 14 shell accounts attempted $286,000 synthetic GMV.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Retain genuine compliance-gap holds pending FEMA and UBO documentation, and continue nightly OFAC/UN/PEP screening with device-graph and GSTIN clustering.

executive_summary.headline: AetherSonic Gains Brand-Gated Storefront Protection Backed by $18M Year-1 Allocation
executive_summary.narrative: AetherSonic would list 28 SKUs as Official Brand Storefront with SKU-level brand gating blocking 19 grey-market resellers, serial capture at pack-out, and a +/-0.5% MAP buy-box lock. NovaMart offers referral commission reduced from 11.5% to 9.75%, saving roughly $315k annually, plus a $3.65 FBO fee versus $4.40 standard. AetherSonic commits $18.0M Year-1 inventory and $480k minimum co-op spend, with 45-day StudioPulse X2 exclusivity.
executive_summary.bottom_line_impact: Net AetherSonic benefit: $954k return savings offsets $315k commission concession and FBO subsidy, against $480k co-op spend.

key_findings.theme: Grey-Market and MAP Leakage Exposure
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Unauthorized resellers undercut MAP by 14%-19% on ANC-Pro headphones at $299 MSRP, against a $31.2M current marketplace GMV base; NovaMart blocks 19 known resellers at ingestion with 2.0% leakage unwind trigger.

key_findings.theme: Returns and Fulfillment Economics
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Transit crush returns fall from 7.4% to 2.1% under NovaMart double-walled overbox, worth roughly $954,000 annualized GMV retention; delivery improves from 4.1 days to 1.3 days across four regional hubs.

key_findings.theme: Commercial Concession Balance
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Commission cut from 11.5% to 9.75% saves $315,000 yearly on $18.0M GMV, while FBO drops $4.40 to $3.65 per unit; net NovaMart take rate including ads is 12.42%, against $480,000 guaranteed co-op spend.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Grey-market leakage above 2.0% over any 14-day audit window triggers AetherSonic's 30-day exclusivity unwind right, threatening the StudioPulse X2 launch and the $18.0M allocation commitment.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Enroll all 28 UPCs into Brand Registry Lock by January 10, 2027, auto-rejecting third-party offers lacking a signed Authorized Distributor Token, with 14-day leakage audits.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: Only 26 of 28 SKUs have UN38.3 certifications uploaded, with 2 pending lab signoff, risking hazmat quarantine stalls for launch inventory.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Require pre-cleared UN38.3 certification for all 28 SKUs at onboarding before inventory is released, avoiding per-lot manual holds.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.domain: Settlement Credit and Return Reserve Exposure
risk_and_compliance_matrix.exposure_summary: T+3 settlement versus standard T+7 accelerates cash release, backed only by a $250,000 rolling reserve, while Treasury requires Director approval and zero unresolved KYC/TIN mismatches.
risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Gate T+3 release on Director approval and zero KYC/TIN mismatches, stepping down the reserve only after 60-day return rates stay at or below 2.5% at QBRs.

action_plan.milestone: Enroll all 28 AetherSonic UPCs and EANs into Brand Registry Lock, enforcing Authorized Distributor Token validation and auto-rejecting unauthorized third-party offers at ingestion.
action_plan.verification_metric: 100% of 28 SKUs locked; zero unauthorized offers live

action_plan.milestone: Complete lab signoff and upload UN38.3 certifications for the two pending SKUs so all 28 launch SKUs clear hazmat holds before Go-Live.
action_plan.verification_metric: 28 of 28 UN38.3 certificates verified and approved

action_plan.milestone: Execute Day 30, 60, and 90 QBRs auditing net ROAS against 4.8x, 14-day MAP leakage below 2.0%, and 60-day returns at or below 2.5% before reserve step-down.
action_plan.verification_metric: ROAS at or above 4.8x; leakage below 2.0%; returns at or below 2.5%

executive_summary.narrative: On August 29, 2026, FC-PUNE-02 Zone-C detected thermal runaway in a misdeclared seller carton (Seller SLR-77401) reaching 118C; ERT isolated the pallet in 260 seconds with zero injuries and main operations resumed by 08:30 IST. A 412-SKU fleet audit verified 334 compliant SKUs, suspended 63, and permanently delisted 15 SKUs across 4 terminated sellers. key_findings.theme: Containment performance and zero personnel exposure
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Thermal escalation from 47C to 118C over 9 minutes was detected within 110 seconds; ERT isolated the pallet in 260 seconds with zero injuries and operations resumed by 08:30 IST.

key_findings.theme: Seller misdeclaration and falsified certification
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Forensic teardown found 26,800mAh (99.16Wh) cells in shells labeled 10,000mAh (37Wh), and a forged BIS certificate was submitted; 154 units remain in destruction custody.

key_findings.theme: Marketplace-wide fleet audit outcome
key_findings.quantified_evidence: Of 412 SKUs audited across 118 sellers, 334 (81.1%) were compliant, 63 (15.3%) suspended, and 15 (3.6%) delisted; 548 recall units remain unreturned.

risk_and_compliance_matrix.mitigation_control: Hard TMS API block on >37Wh batteries and Category 1 OCR contradiction gate now prevent undeclared lithium-ion entering passenger or belly air manifests.
